_comment: Settings for the Saaz email templates. Change a value, run: python3 tools/make_email_templates.py, then paste the 4 files into Supabase. Empty value = that line is left out of the emails.
_image_base: Emails can't carry images inside them. Email apps download each image from this public address, so images only show once the site is shipped.
_phone: PLACEHOLDER. Shown as 'Call us'. Digits with country code, e.g. +2567XXXXXXXX. Empty = hidden.
_legal_name: ASSUMPTION: registered company name not confirmed (the email domain suggests Saaz Investments Ltd). Same as legalName in src/data/site.json.
_address: PLACEHOLDER. Add the street address once confirmed.
_social: PLACEHOLDER URLs: paste each profile link, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@yourhandle. Empty url = that button is left out. If the icon file exists in src/assets/img/ it is shown; if not, the name is shown in a round button.
